notes: Definitions the build must refuse, each with the text its BuildException must contain, run by tools/meshops-check.
Each case's definition is base with its meshes, with set's keys replaced and drop's keys removed, or its text as written.
{abs} stands for the absolute path (with /) of the copy of vehicle/meshes/part.obj the check builds beside.
Before each case the output folder holds a previous build (a.obj); a refusal must leave it as it was and write nothing else.
error null: the definition must build.
